stem: By referring to Emily Post in both the beginning and ending of the article, the author —

options.label: A
options.text: implies that etiquette focuses too much on others’ feelings and not enough on a person’s own actions

options.label: B
options.text: suggests that traditional ideas about etiquette do not apply to the digital etiquette needed today

options.label: C
options.text: implies that hosting a party based on the information from Emily Post’s book would be difficult today

options.label: D
options.text: communicates that even though some etiquette rules may be outdated, the need to have manners is still important today
